description: Find creators and businesses on Piku: photographers, studios, hotels and more. Match by words (what they do, niche, Rates; related work counts), a place (city, region or country), a category, a language, or a point and radius. kind: creator, business or any (claimed pages first). Results show where each is, whether it is claimed and when it changed; unclaimed business pages have no prices and take no requests. max_from_price is compared across currencies. Pass next_cursor back as cursor. If nothing matches as asked, the search widens step by step and widened says what changed: tell the user. If still nothing, note gives a next step.

category.description: Like hotel, boutique hotel, guesthouse, lodge, womenswear, beauty, bridal, studio, photographer

kind.description: Creators, businesses or both. Default any.

language.description: A language the page lists, like French

location.description: A city, a country name or code, or both, like Grand-Bassam, Cote d'Ivoire

near.description: Business pages within km (default 25) of a point

what.description: Words like wedding photographer, boutique hotel, code reviews

name: search
title: Find people and places
